wet_nag_support_cult_10 = {
  set_variable = {
    wet_nag_share_neutrality = party_popularity_100@neutrality
  }
  set_variable = {
    wet_nag_share_fascism = party_popularity_100@fascism
  }
  set_variable = {
    wet_nag_share_democratic = party_popularity_100@democratic
  }
  set_variable = {
    wet_nag_share_communism = party_popularity_100@communism
  }
  set_variable = {
    wet_nag_share_waaagh = party_popularity_100@waaagh
  }
  set_variable = {
    wet_nag_share_horned_rat = party_popularity_100@horned_rat
  }
  set_variable = {
    wet_nag_shift = 10
  }
  clamp_variable = {
    var = wet_nag_shift
    min = 0
    max = wet_nag_share_neutrality
  }
  subtract_from_variable = {
    wet_nag_share_neutrality = wet_nag_shift
  }
  add_to_variable = {
    wet_nag_share_fascism = wet_nag_shift
  }
  set_popularities = {
    neutrality = wet_nag_share_neutrality
    fascism = wet_nag_share_fascism
    democratic = wet_nag_share_democratic
    communism = wet_nag_share_communism
    waaagh = wet_nag_share_waaagh
    horned_rat = wet_nag_share_horned_rat
  }
}

wet_nag_send_surrender = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      tag = H12
      wet_nag_morathi_available = yes
      NOT = {
        has_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_surrender
      }
      check_variable = {
        wet_nag_offer_surrender_cooldown
        <
        1
      }
      NOT = {
        has_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_surrender_accepted
      }
      OR = {
        NOT = {
          has_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_surrender_attempted
        }
        H12 = {
          has_political_power
          >
          24
        }
      }
    }
    if = {
      limit = {
        has_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_surrender_attempted
      }
      H12 = {
        add_political_power = -25
      }
    }
    set_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_surrender_attempted
    set_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_surrender
    set_variable = {
      wet_nag_offer_surrender_days = 30
    }
    H12 = {
      if = {
        limit = {
          NOT = {
            is_in_array = {
              wet_nag_active_recipients = PREV
            }
          }
        }
        add_to_array = {
          wet_nag_active_recipients = PREV
        }
      }
    }
    country_event = {
      id = wet_naggaroth.101
    }
  }
}

      H12 = {
        NOT = {
          has_country_flag = wet_nag_morathi_dead
        }
      }
      NOT = {
        has_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_release_morathi
      }
      check_variable = {
        wet_nag_offer_release_morathi_cooldown
        <
        1
      }
      NOT = {
        has_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_release_morathi_accepted
      }
      OR = {
        NOT = {
          has_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_release_morathi_attempted
        }
        H12 = {
          has_political_power
          >
          24
        }
      }
    }
    if = {
      limit = {
        has_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_release_morathi_attempted
      }
      H12 = {
        add_political_power = -25
      }
    }
    set_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_release_morathi_attempted
    set_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_release_morathi
    set_variable = {
      wet_nag_offer_release_morathi_days = 30
    }
    H12 = {
      if = {
        limit = {
          NOT = {
            is_in_array = {
              wet_nag_active_recipients = PREV
            }
          }
        }
        add_to_array = {
          wet_nag_active_recipients = PREV
        }
      }
    }
    country_event = {
      id = wet_naggaroth.104
    }
  }
}

wet_nag_measure_defending_bloc = {
  clear_array = wet_nag_defender_leaders
  clear_array = wet_nag_defending_countries
  for_each_scope_loop = {
    array = wet_nag_war_targets
    add_to_array = {
      ROOT.wet_nag_defender_leaders = THIS
    }
    if = {
      limit = {
        is_subject = yes
      }
      overlord = {
        add_to_array = {
          ROOT.wet_nag_defender_leaders = THIS
        }
      }
    }
  }
  set_variable = {
    wet_nag_defending_manpower = 0
  }
  for_each_scope_loop = {
    array = wet_nag_defender_leaders
    every_country = {
      limit = {
        exists = yes
        NOT = {
          tag = ROOT
        }
        OR = {
          tag = PREV
          is_subject_of = PREV
          is_in_faction_with = PREV
          PREV = {
            is_guaranteed_by = PREV
          }
        }
        NOT = {
          is_in_array = {
            ROOT.wet_nag_defending_countries = THIS
          }
        }
      }
      add_to_array = {
        ROOT.wet_nag_defending_countries = THIS
      }
      add_to_variable = {
        var = ROOT.wet_nag_defending_manpower
        value = deployed_army_manpower_k
      }
    }
  }
  set_variable = {
    wet_nag_available_manpower = deployed_army_manpower_k
  }
  divide_variable = {
    wet_nag_available_manpower = 1.5
  }
  clear_array = wet_nag_defender_leaders
  clear_array = wet_nag_defending_countries
}
wet_nag_goal_411 = {
  clear_array = wet_nag_war_targets
  411 = {
    owner = {
      H12 = {
        add_to_array = {
          wet_nag_war_targets = PREV
        }
      }
    }
  }
  wet_nag_measure_defending_bloc = yes
  if = {
    limit = {
      411 = {
        owner = {
          wet_nag_legal_enemy = yes
          is_subject = no
          H12 = {
            can_declare_war_on = PREV
          }
        }
        any_neighbor_state = {
          is_owned_by = H12
          is_fully_controlled_by = H12
        }
      }
      OR = {
        NOT = {
          has_country_flag = wet_nag_goal_411_issued
        }
        has_political_power
        >
        24
      }
      OR = {
        is_ai = no
        AND = {
          has_war = no
          check_variable = {
            wet_nag_available_manpower
            >
            wet_nag_defending_manpower
          }
        }
      }
    }
    411 = {
      owner = {
        H12 = {
          create_wargoal = {
            type = wet_nag_conquest
            target = PREV
            generator = {
              411
            }
            expire = 180
          }
          if = {
            limit = {
              NOT = {
                is_in_array = {
                  wet_nag_goal_owners = PREV
                }
              }
            }
            add_to_array = {
              wet_nag_goal_owners = PREV
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if = {
      limit = {
        has_country_flag = wet_nag_goal_411_issued
      }
      add_political_power = -25
    }
    set_country_flag = wet_nag_goal_411_issued
  }
  clear_array = wet_nag_war_targets
}

wet_nag_clean_goals = {
  clear_array = wet_nag_finished_goal_owners
  for_each_scope_loop = {
    array = wet_nag_goal_owners
    if = {
      limit = {
        OR = {
          NOT = {
            exists = yes
          }
          wet_nag_protected_partner = yes
          is_in_faction_with = H12
          is_subject_of = H12
          has_non_aggression_pact_with = H12
        }
      }
      H12 = {
        remove_wargoal = {
          type = wet_nag_conquest
          target = PREV
        }
        add_to_array = {
          wet_nag_finished_goal_owners = PREV
        }
      }
    }
  }
  for_each_scope_loop = {
    array = wet_nag_finished_goal_owners
    H12 = {
      remove_from_array = {
        wet_nag_goal_owners = PREV
      }
    }
  }
  clear_array = wet_nag_finished_goal_owners
}
wet_nag_send_submission_H20 = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      tag = H20
      wet_name_is_dark_elf = yes
      wet_nag_subject_offer_legal = yes
      NOT = {
        has_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_submission_H20
      }
      check_variable = {
        wet_nag_offer_submission_H20_cooldown
        <
        1
      }
      NOT = {
        has_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_submission_H20_accepted
      }
      OR = {
        NOT = {
          has_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_submission_H20_attempted
        }
        H12 = {
          has_political_power
          >
          24
        }
      }
    }
    if = {
      limit = {
        has_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_submission_H20_attempted
      }
      H12 = {
        add_political_power = -25
      }
    }
    set_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_submission_H20_attempted
    set_country_flag = wet_nag_offer_submission_H20
    set_variable = {
      wet_nag_offer_submission_H20_days = 30
    }
    H12 = {
      if = {
        limit = {
          NOT = {
            is_in_array = {
              wet_nag_active_recipients = PREV
            }
          }
        }
        add_to_array = {
          wet_nag_active_recipients = PREV
        }
      }
    }
    country_event = {
      id = wet_naggaroth.106
    }
  }
}

wet_focus_actions_naggaroth = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      has_country_flag = wet_nag_investigate_cult_focus_running
    }
    if = {
      limit = {
        NOT = {
          AND = {
            controls_state = 812

          }
        }
      }
      clr_country_flag = wet_nag_investigate_cult_focus_running
      set_variable = {
        wet_nag_investigate_cult_focus_days = 0
      }

      }
